findings.title: Commit subject exceeds 100-char limit
findings.problem: Subject of commit acf147b1 (fix(providers): ignore stored expiry of cookie-only SSO credentials in health and status ...) is 105 chars after the type/scope prefix; git-workflow.md and commitlint.config.cjs set subject-max-length to 100.
findings.impact: commit-msg hook (commitlint error level) would reject it, so the commit breaks the documented commit format.
findings.recommendation: Reword the subject to 100 characters or fewer, e.g. shorten the trailing task suffix or drop 'stored'.

findings.title: Every 401 treated as dead SSO session
findings.problem: isSessionRejection401 is status-only (statusCode === 401). The spec's capture step for real expired-cookie and non-session 401s was not done, so AC8 (non-session 401 starts no sign-in) cannot be met for the first occurrence; a denied-model or relayed upstream 401 marks analytics auth invalid, drains the body and opens a browser sign-in. Only the post-sign-in loop guard, lock and cooldown bound it. Reachability: the plugin calls the predicate directly on all upstream responses.
findings.impact: Spurious browser sign-ins and rewritten 401 bodies for non-session failures; AC8 only partially met.
findings.recommendation: Decide: capture real gateway 401s and narrow the predicate (body/header marker), or accept the documented status-only fallback and record it as a known limitation with the spec owner.
findings.check_notes: Decision recorded: accept status-only predicate as known limitation; documented in session-rejection.ts and pinned by a test.

fix.change: Accepted status-only predicate; limitation made explicit in session-rejection.ts header and pinned by a test

decision.outcome: (b) accept status-only predicate as a known limitation
decision.rationale: No real gateway 401 captures exist; loop guard, lock and cooldown bound spurious sign-ins; limitation documented in code and test

findings.title: No test for assistants-chat credential load
findings.problem: AC4 requires both sdk-client and assistants-chat credential load to succeed with a 24h+1min-old cookie-only credential; only sdk-client is covered.
findings.impact: A required acceptance criterion is only partially verified; a regression in the assistants-chat load path would go unnoticed.
findings.recommendation: Add a test for the assistants-chat credential load using a stale cookie-only credential, asserting it loads and is not deleted.
findings.check_notes: sdk-client.test.ts now covers getAuthenticatedClient with a 24h+1min stale cookie-only credential, asserting no clear and client creation.
